reading: Consumers are experiencing significant financial pressure due to the escalating cost of protein supplements.
Amarpreet Singh, who has consumed protein shakes since age 16, has witnessed a substantial increase in prices over fourteen years.
A 4.5kg bag of whey protein he purchased for around £60 in 2020 had soared to £120 by last year, though he secured one for less via eBay.
Among his gym peers, this upward trend in protein costs has colloquially been termed "proteinflation."
Over recent years, protein powders have attracted a considerably wider demographic, with food manufacturers diversifying into high-protein versions of various everyday items.
Nineteen-year-old student Evie Lewis recently started using protein powder as she believed her diet lacked sufficient protein.
She finds the £32.99 price for a 420g tub prohibitive, leading her to conserve the product by using less than the recommended amount.
Max Longman, a long-term user, notes his monthly expenditure on whey protein has climbed from approximately £45 to £60 within the last year.
The burgeoning demand for protein is exacerbated by new weight-loss drugs, whose users are often advised to maintain adequate protein intake to preserve muscle mass.
This surging appetite, however, is encountering a significant obstacle: supply has not grown sufficiently to meet the heightened consumption.
Consequently, wholesale prices for crucial ingredients have sharply escalated, intensifying the pressure on consumers.
For instance, the European wholesale price of a common high-protein whey type was 130% higher in late August compared to the previous year, and more than four times its value three years ago.
Manufacturers acknowledge that increasing production is both time-consuming and capital-intensive, particularly as high-protein whey processing demands specialized equipment.
Some companies, like UK sports nutrition firm Warrior, are exploring alternative protein sources to mitigate production costs.
Kieran Fisher, Warrior's founder, indicated that their whey protein powder's shelf price rose from £12.50 to £17.99, yet the company still subsidises it.
While wholesale prices for high-protein whey have stabilised recently, they remain substantially elevated compared to several years prior.
Despite these increases, committed users like Max view protein as increasingly vital for post-exercise recovery, making it a widespread staple.
Conversely, students like Evie, operating on stringent budgets, are less inclined to continue purchasing it, deeming it a dispensable item for now.
Amarpreet considers continued protein consumption a luxury and is seeking a more affordable brand, though he expects to pay around £100 per bag.

vocabulary.definition: Increasing rapidly in intensity, amount, or size; becoming more severe or serious.
Of considerable importance, size, or worth; significantly large.
Increased very quickly to a high level, often used for prices, temperatures, or amounts.
In a way that is used in ordinary or familiar conversation; informally.
A particular sector of a population, especially one defined by age, sex, income, etc.
Expanding the range of products, services, or activities, often to reduce risk or increase opportunities.
So high or expensive as to prevent or discourage people from buying or doing something.
To protect something from harm or destruction, or to use something sparingly so as not to deplete it.
The act of spending or using money; an amount of money spent.
Beginning to grow or increase rapidly; flourishing.
Made a problem, bad situation, or negative feeling worse.
To make something less severe, serious, or painful; to lessen the gravity of an offence or mistake.
Supports an organisation or activity financially, often by covering part of the costs.
Strict, precise, and exacting; especially of regulations, requirements, or conditions.
Able to be replaced or done without; not essential.

entries.ja: 強度、量、または大きさが急速に増加していること。より深刻または重大になっていること。
entries.ko: 강도, 양, 또는 크기가 빠르게 증가하는 것; 더욱 심각하거나 중대해지는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 在强度、数量或规模上迅速增加；变得更严重或更严峻。
entries.es: Que aumenta rápidamente en intensidad, cantidad o tamaño; que se vuelve más grave o serio.
entries.pt-BR: Que está aumentando rapidamente em intensidade, quantidade ou tamanho; que está se tornando mais grave ou sério.

entries.ja: かなりの重要性、大きさ、または価値があること。著しく大きいこと。
entries.ko: 상당한 중요성, 크기, 또는 가치가 있는; 현저하게 큰.
entries.zh-Hans: 具有相当的重要性、规模或价值；显著地大。
entries.es: De considerable importancia, tamaño o valor; significativamente grande.
entries.pt-BR: De considerável importância, tamanho ou valor; significativamente grande.

entries.ja: 価格、気温、量などが非常に急速に高い水準まで増加した。
entries.ko: 가격, 온도, 수량 등이 매우 빠르게 높은 수준으로 증가했다.
entries.zh-Hans: 迅速上升到高水平，常用于描述价格、温度或数量。
entries.es: Aumentó muy rápidamente a un nivel alto, a menudo usado para precios, temperaturas o cantidades.
entries.pt-BR: Aumentou muito rapidamente para um nível alto, frequentemente usado para preços, temperaturas ou quantidades.

entries.ja: 日常のまたは親しい会話で使われる方法で。非公式に。
entries.ko: 일상적이거나 친근한 대화에서 사용되는 방식으로; 비공식적으로.
entries.zh-Hans: 以在普通或熟悉的对话中使用的方式；非正式地。
entries.es: De una manera que se usa en la conversación ordinaria o familiar; informalmente.
entries.pt-BR: De uma maneira usada em conversas comuns ou familiares; informalmente.

entries.ja: 特に年齢、性別、収入などで定義される、人口の特定の部門。
entries.ko: 인구의 특정 부분, 특히 연령, 성별, 수입 등으로 정의되는 부분.
entries.zh-Hans: 人口的特定部分，尤其指按年龄、性别、收入等划分的群体。
entries.es: Un sector particular de una población, especialmente uno definido por la edad, el sexo, los ingresos, etc.
entries.pt-BR: Um setor particular de uma população, especialmente um definido por idade, sexo, renda, etc.

entries.ja: 製品、サービス、または活動の範囲を広げること。多くの場合、リスクを減らしたり機会を増やしたりするため。
entries.ko: 제품, 서비스 또는 활동의 범위를 확장하는 것, 종종 위험을 줄이거나 기회를 늘리기 위해.
entries.zh-Hans: 扩大产品、服务或活动的范围，通常是为了降低风险或增加机会。
entries.es: Expandir la gama de productos, servicios o actividades, a menudo para reducir riesgos o aumentar oportunidades.
entries.pt-BR: Expandir a gama de produtos, serviços ou atividades, frequentemente para reduzir riscos ou aumentar oportunidades.

entries.ja: 高価である、または高額であるため、人々が何かを買ったり行ったりするのを妨げたり諦めさせたりする。
entries.ko: 너무 높거나 비싸서 사람들이 무언가를 사거나 하는 것을 막거나 단념하게 만드는.
entries.zh-Hans: 高昂到足以阻止或劝退人们购买或做某事。
entries.es: Tan alto o caro que impide o disuade a las personas de comprar o hacer algo.
entries.pt-BR: Tão alto ou caro a ponto de impedir ou desencorajar as pessoas de comprar ou fazer algo.

entries.ja: 何かを危害や破壊から守ること、または何かを使い果たさないように控えめに使用すること。
entries.ko: 무언가를 해롭거나 파괴되지 않도록 보호하거나, 고갈되지 않도록 아껴서 사용하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 保护某物免受伤害或破坏，或节约使用某物以防耗尽。
entries.es: Proteger algo del daño o la destrucción, o usar algo con moderación para no agotarlo.
entries.pt-BR: Proteger algo de danos ou destruição, ou usar algo com moderação para não esgotá-lo.

entries.ja: お金を使う行為、または使われた金額。
entries.ko: 돈을 지출하거나 사용하는 행위; 지출된 금액.
entries.zh-Hans: 花钱或使用金钱的行为；花费的金额。
entries.es: El acto de gastar o usar dinero; una cantidad de dinero gastada.
entries.pt-BR: O ato de gastar ou usar dinheiro; uma quantia de dinheiro gasta.

entries.ja: 急速に成長または増加し始めている。繁栄している。
entries.zh-Hans: 开始迅速增长或增加；繁荣的。
entries.es: Que empieza a crecer o aumentar rápidamente; floreciente.
entries.pt-BR: Que começa a crescer ou aumentar rapidamente; florescente.

entries.ja: 問題、悪い状況、または否定的な感情をより悪化させた。
entries.ko: 문제, 나쁜 상황 또는 부정적인 감정을 더욱 악화시켰다.
entries.zh-Hans: 使问题、不良情况或负面情绪变得更糟。
entries.es: Hizo un problema, una mala situación o un sentimiento negativo peor.
entries.pt-BR: Tornou um problema, uma situação ruim ou um sentimento negativo pior.

entries.ja: 何かをより厳しくなく、より深刻でなく、またはより苦痛でなくすること。犯罪や間違いの重大さを軽減すること。
entries.ko: 무언가를 덜 심각하게, 덜 중대하게, 또는 덜 고통스럽게 만드는 것; 범죄나 실수의 심각성을 줄이는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 使某事不那么严峻、不那么严重或不那么痛苦；减轻罪行或错误的严重性。
entries.es: Hacer que algo sea menos severo, grave o doloroso; disminuir la gravedad de una ofensa o error.
entries.pt-BR: Tornar algo menos severo, sério ou doloroso; diminuir a gravidade de uma ofensa ou erro.

entries.ja: 組織や活動を財政的に支援すること。多くの場合、費用の一部を負担することによって。
entries.ko: 기관이나 활동을 재정적으로 지원하는 것, 종종 비용의 일부를 부담함으로써.
entries.zh-Hans: 为组织或活动提供经济支持，通常通过承担部分成本。
entries.es: Apoya financieramente una organización o actividad, a menudo cubriendo parte de los costos.
entries.pt-BR: Apoia financeiramente uma organização ou atividade, frequentemente cobrindo parte dos custos.

entries.ja: 厳格で、正確で、厳密なこと。特に規則、要件、または条件について。
entries.ko: 엄격하고, 정확하며, 까다로운; 특히 규정, 요구 사항 또는 조건에 대해.
entries.zh-Hans: 严格、精确和严谨的；尤指规定、要求或条件。
entries.es: Estricto, preciso y exigente; especialmente de regulaciones, requisitos o condiciones.
entries.pt-BR: Estrito, preciso e exigente; especialmente de regulamentos, requisitos ou condições.

entries.ja: 交換できる、またはなくても済むこと。不可欠ではないこと。
entries.ko: 교체할 수 있거나 없어도 괜찮은; 필수가 아닌.
entries.zh-Hans: 可以被替换或不需要的；非必需的。
entries.es: Que puede ser reemplazado o de lo que se puede prescindir; no esencial.
entries.pt-BR: Que pode ser substituído ou dispensado; não essencial.
